summary: Official Ripple material confirms RLUSD became available through Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and retail app on Oct 28, with XRPL/Base/Ethereum rails; Coinbase Global Exchange collateral use remains a future rollout. Secondary ETF trackers disagree in units, fund coverage and settlement status, including an internal 3/5 versus 5/5 reporting contradiction on one dashboard. No ETF-flow feature admitted; no synchronized XRP market panel or forecast produced. PR #1325 and #1326 exact-head CI/gates pass but both remain draft/unmerged.

findings.claim: Ripple and Coinbase announced RLUSD availability on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and retail app starting Oct 28, with deposits/withdrawals across XRPL, Base and Ethereum. Coinbase Global Exchange collateral availability was described as a future rollout, not live collateral usage at the announcement cutoff.
findings.limitation: Announcement proves availability scope, not executed volume, net XRP demand or collateral utilization.

findings.claim: Reuters reports Coinbase broadened stablecoin offerings beyond its USDC-centered offering to include RLUSD, PYUSD and Open USD, consistent with multi-issuer distribution.
findings.limitation: No current USDC/RLUSD balance mix or share-shift measurement admitted; one report does not establish displacement.

findings.claim: ETF trackers report different XRP flow quantities and scopes: Alpha Finance says $0 on Oct 28 across five funds; XRP Insights reports −3.13M XRP for Oct 26–27 across six spot funds plus BITW and marks Oct 28 provisional; CryptoETF.today contains a 3/5 versus 5/5 reporting inconsistency; XRP Desk reports approximately −4,000 XRP with a different/unreconciled universe.
findings.limitation: Do not average, infer net capital flows or admit as a model feature until fund-level issuer holdings and settlement cutoffs are normalized.

findings.claim: Coinbase Q3 results are scheduled for Oct 29 after US market close; Circle Q3 results are scheduled for Nov 4 at 8:00 a.m. ET.
findings.limitation: These are scheduled disclosures, not evidence of realized results or directional XRP price effects.

market_observations.reason_not_admitted: Not reconciled against issuer-level fund holdings and other tracker universes.

market_observations.scope: 6 spot funds plus BITW per XRP Insights
market_observations.reason_not_admitted: Different dates and fund population; Oct 28 row provisional.
Page simultaneously says 3/5 and 5/5 funds reported; needs source-file reconciliation.

market_observations.scope: Tracked products; precise universe not reconciled
market_observations.reason_not_admitted: Universe and aggregation differ; do not average with other trackers.
